name: What Lurks in Dark Corners
source:
A dark forest where family ties are tested and old wounds come to light.

[From [url=https://crowvis.itch.io/what-lurks-in-dark-corners]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一片幽暗森林之中，亲情羁绊面临严峻考验，陈年旧伤也再度暴露于阳光之下。

[摘自[url=https://crowvis.itch.io/what-lurks-in-dark-corners]itch.io[/url]]
